title: Event
description: Domain-level research event (PRD §6 'Event'): an ordered, append-only, reconnectable projection of research activity, persisted as state projection and forwarded to the UI already redacted. Payloads must never contain secrets, credentials, raw provider prompts, or raw provider responses; emitters redact at construction and readers treat this schema as a floor, not a license to include sensitive material. Transport-level worker events are a separate contract (worker-event.v1.json). Draft producers in apps/ migrate to this contract in a later task (ADR-015).

event_id.description: Stable event identifier; identical across replays (UUIDv7 by convention).

sequence.description: Strictly increasing per run (per project for project-level events); reconnect cursors resume after the last seen sequence.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of when the event occurred (convention, not format-asserted).

run_id.description: Owning run. Absent (preferred) or null for project-level events, which use a project-scoped sequence space.

task_id.description: Task the event is about for task.* events; may also be carried inside the payload.

type.description: Closed domain vocabulary grouped by prefix (task./run./plan./source./claim./review.) and aligned with the research-task, research-run, and research-plan status machines. Transport job.* types belong to worker-event.v1.json, not here.

summary.description: Optional human-readable one-line summary for timeline projections.

payload.description: Type-discriminated, already-redacted event details; the shape is governed by the emitting event type and stays permissive here. Must never contain secrets or raw provider prompts/responses.
